eps.o: New Amato and Gregg Turkington are back for Season 17 of On Cinema at the Cinema! Come over to the cantina, have an NA IPA and learn a thing or two about movies, life, bankruptcy, boating accidents, and more. Plus, find out whether this weekend's Hollywood premieres are five-baggers and finally get the Buff's take on the Summer blockbuster The Odyssey!

It is always a good time at New's Movie Lounge! Pour up a cold beverage, find out what movie to watch this weekend, and learn about the most mysterious organ, the brain. We also get a much-needed update on Deb's birds Roscoe and Chi-Chi and a big new idea from the Amato Foundation.

eps.t: ‘The Cat in the Hat’ and ‘Wild Horse Nine’
eps.o: Welcome to New's Movie Lounge. This is the kind of show where you chat life and technology and talk sports and have NA or A drinks. On this episode we have a very special guest to help uncover the keys to the universe. Plus we learn about two new Hollywood Hits ‘The Cat in the Hat’ and ‘Wild Horse Nine’. Are they Five Baggers? And a Dootle Dots Movie update.

Family is the most important thing on On Cinema. And in this episode we see New Amato fight for his with the Miracle March to Phoenix in association with Miracle Tubs™️. CEO of the HEI Network and longtime returning guest Gregg Turkington also delivers some much-needed movie expertise on this week's Hollywood hits.

eps.t: 'I Play Rocky' and 'The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping'
eps.o: Impressionist Maestro Mark Porke makes his On Cinema return after a battle with various illnesses and misfortunes to talk about the new Dootle Dots Movie production. And Buff Gregg Turkington gives an unprecedented Movie Review...
